link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/README.md" id="dk_all"> <mxCell parent="dkey" style="rounded=1;arcSize=20;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=1.5;fontSize=11;fontColor=#FBBF24;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="54" width="318" x="1978" y="108" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D1" tooltip="D1 - Two platforms, not one
Decision: keep the trusted nightly warehouse; add a lakehouse for event and integration use cases.
Alternatives: migrate everything to the lakehouse; add near-real-time loads to the warehouse.
Why: no big-bang migration risk; each platform does what it is best at.
Revisit when: most consumers need sub-day freshness.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-two-platforms-not-one.md" id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-347"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="34" x="1183" y="240" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D2" tooltip="D2 - Temporal ODS family
Decision: separate current, effective-dated, future-dated, history and full ODS sharing one code base.
Alternatives: a single SCD2 staging table; snapshots only.
Why: back-dated corrections and future-dated changes are handled without corrupting current state; full replay is possible.
Trade-off: more databases to run, mitigated by one commit promoted to all.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-temporal-ods-family.md" id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-348"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="28" x="1146" y="1113" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D3" tooltip="D3 - Dependency-tiered batch
Decision: jobs start when their predecessors finish (dependency graph with gates); a small number of anchor jobs start on a clock.
Alternatives: fixed clock schedule; one sequential chain.
Why: independent work runs in parallel, the critical path shrinks, completion adapts to daily volume.
Trade-off: the dependency graph must be maintained as configuration.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-dependency-tiered-batch.md" id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-349"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="28" x="1146" y="663" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D4" tooltip="D4 - Federation over replication
Decision: the lakehouse reads conformed dimensions from the warehouse at query time through a few governed views.
Alternatives: replicate dimensions into Delta; CDC copy.
Why: one version of the truth, no sync lag, no duplicate pipelines.
Guardrails: approved views only, resolve keys at ETL time, monitor latency and source load.
Revisit when: concurrency or latency targets are missed, then materialize.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0004-federation-over-replication.md" id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-350"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="34" x="1183" y="2385" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D5" tooltip="D5 - Blocking vs alerting data quality
Decision: a blocking gate before the warehouse publish; alert-only checks in the lakehouse.
Why: enterprise reporting should show yesterday's good data rather than today's bad data; operational integrations must keep flowing and reconcile later.
Alternatives: block everywhere; alert everywhere.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0005-blocking-vs-alerting-dq.md" id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-351"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="28" x="705" y="2218" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D6" tooltip="D6 - BI tool by audience
Decision: composite BI model for the broad governed audience; live SQL dashboard for a small ops team; imported dashboards for lakehouse business users.
Why: match freshness, row-level security and cost to who is reading.
Alternatives: one tool and one refresh mode for everyone.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0006-bi-tool-by-audience.md" id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-352"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="28" x="2326" y="2693" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D7" tooltip="D7 - Medallion only where it adds value
Decision: an integration gets Bronze/Silver/Gold only if it builds history, has an analytical audience and answers questions no other source can. One integration is deliberately skipped.
Why: avoids building and running models nobody uses.
Revisit when: a new audience or question appears.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0007-selective-medallion.md" id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-353"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="28" x="2326" y="2183" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D8" tooltip="D8 - Change detection by content compare
Decision: detect changes by comparing content (set-based compare, or row hash for wide entities), excluding volatile columns such as load stamps.
Alternatives: source timestamps; full nightly reload; database-native CDC.
Why: timestamps produce false changes and miss real ones; downstream feeds should receive only true changes.
Trade-off: compare cost grows with width and volume; excluded-column list must be maintained.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0008-change-detection-strategy.md" id="dec8"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="28" x="650" y="1560" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D9" tooltip="D9 - Idempotent loads and safe re-runs
Decision: every load is safe to run twice. Watermarks advance only after full success; upserts instead of blind inserts; additive merges only with a run log that rejects already-processed inputs.
Alternatives: manual cleanup before re-runs; truncate-and-reload everything.
Why: any failed job can be re-run without analysis, with no gaps and no double counting.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0009-idempotent-loads.md" id="dec9"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=10;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="28" x="1140" y="772" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D10" tooltip="D10 - Kimball dimensional model
Decision: star schema / constellation with conformed dimensions, SCD Type 2 where history matters, role-playing dimensions and several fact types.
Alternatives: 3NF enterprise model; Data Vault; reporting on raw views.
Why: intuitive for a large self-service audience and BI tools; consistent KPIs; fast queries.
Trade-off: ETL build effort; schema changes ripple through the model.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0010-kimball-dimensional-model.md" id="dec10"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=9;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="28" x="280" y="2220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D11" tooltip="D11 - Defense-in-depth security
Decision: layered controls: schema separation by sensitivity tier, row-level security in BI, DirectQuery for highly restricted facts, restricted data kept out of federation, data minimization for feeds.
Alternatives: row-level security only; separate physical databases per tier.
Why: a failure in one layer does not expose data.
Trade-off: role mappings must stay in sync across layers.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0011-defense-in-depth-security.md" id="dec11"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=9;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="28" x="1140" y="1636" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D12" tooltip="D12 - Bronze captures transient source data
Decision: capture every inbound payload as received, append-only, before it is transformed, encrypted or forwarded.
Why: some sources keep no history; without capture, trend analysis and replay are impossible.
Trade-off: retention cost; raw sensitive data in Bronze must be governed.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0012-bronze-captures-transient-sources.md" id="dec12"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=9;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="28" x="2310" y="1410" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="D13" tooltip="D13 - Fact and dimension design patterns
Decision: consolidated facts with a source-type column when several systems record the same event; junk dimensions for low-cardinality flags; weighted bridges for many-to-many; role-playing dimensions.
Alternatives: one fact per source; flags on facts; unweighted bridges.
Why: one place to query, correct totals, leaner facts.
Click to open the ADR." link="https://github.com/srimarrivada/Hybrid-HR-Data-Platform-Reference-Architecture/blob/main/docs/adr/0013-fact-design-patterns.md" id="dec13"> <mxCell parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="ellipse;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;aspect=fixed;fillColor=#0F172A;strokeColor=#FBBF24;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#FBBF24;fontSize=9;fontStyle=1;shadow=1;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="28" x="411" y="2220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <mxCell id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-354" parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-346" style="swimlane;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;startSize=34;fillColor=#B71C1C;fontColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#7F1D1D;fontStyle=1;fontSize=15;align=left;spacingLeft=14;swimlaneFillColor=#FFFAFA;rounded=1;arcSize=1;collapsible=1;" value="FAILURE &amp; RECOVERY PATHS: What happens when things go wrong (Click a card to jump to that section)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="190" width="2320" x="40" y="4200" as="geometry"> <mxRectangle height="34" width="900" x="40" y="4200" as="alternateBounds" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-360" parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-354" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=11;fontColor=#7F1D1D;" value="<b>D1–D13</b>&nbsp;(gold circles) = Design decisions: Hover for the trade-off, click for the ADR.&nbsp;&nbsp;<b>F1–F5</b> = Failure paths: Click to jump to the affected section" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="2300" x="10" y="148" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="EH1S9GchiQGYpskucD9f-0" connectable="0" parent="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-354" style="group" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="86" width="2300" x="10" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <UserObject label="<b>F1 - Nightly run fails part-way</b><hr>• Extraction window is NOT advanced (postload runs only on full success)<br>• Next run re-extracts the same window → no data gaps<br>• Resume from the failed step using restart flags" link="data:action/json,{"actions":[{"scroll":{"cells":["bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-69"]}}]}" id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-355"> <mxCell parent="EH1S9GchiQGYpskucD9f-0" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5F5;strokeColor=#C62828;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;fontSize=10;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=4;spacingRight=6;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="86" width="452" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="<b>F2 - DQ gate below threshold</b><hr>• Publish stopped · previous warehouse version stays live<br>• BI keeps yesterday's import · alert raises a ticket<br>• Fix the data, then re-run only the publish step" link="data:action/json,{"actions":[{"scroll":{"cells":["bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-201"]}}]}" id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-356"> <mxCell parent="EH1S9GchiQGYpskucD9f-0" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5F5;strokeColor=#C62828;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;fontSize=10;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=4;spacingRight=6;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="86" width="452" x="462" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="<b>F3 - Integration record or API call fails</b><hr>• Record marked FAILED, the batch continues<br>• Token refresh + retries · scheduled retry or manual reprocess<br>• Replay from Bronze / raw event archive" link="data:action/json,{"actions":[{"scroll":{"cells":["bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-152"]}}]}" id="bVKumJbvJyEJEweoQE7_-357"> <mxCell parent="EH1S9GchiQGYpskucD9f-0" style="rounded=1;arcSize=6;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5F5;strokeColor=#C62828;strokeWidth=2;dashed=1;fontSize=10;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=8;spacingTop=4;spacingRight=6;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="86" width="452" x="924" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> <UserObject label="<b>F4 - div.div:
API extraction• Per worker domain: incremental · effective-dated · future-dated pulls
• Reference + custom-report workflows
• Window = last success − overlap buffer (eventual consistency)
• Staggered to respect API connection limits
• Hierarchical XML → PK/FK tables, no business logic

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(46, 139, 122), rgb(74, 154, 140));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 347px; height: 1px; padding-top: 772px; margin-left: 394px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
File extraction• Vendor files via SFTP / MFT, key auth, retries
• Timestamped archive · stale-file rejection
• Ordered loads where totals depend on each other
• Run-log idempotency for cumulative feeds
• Restricted feed: atomic replace, a failed load keeps prior data

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(86, 81, 126), rgb(164, 160, 198));

div.div:
Orchestration
• Enterprise scheduler: a small number of anchor jobs start on a clock, everything else on dependency• Scheduler job → orchestrator → wrapper → ETL session
• Config-driven dependency graph (chains · fan-out · gates)
• Pause / retry / resume flags · run audit
• Completion time moves with daily change volume

div.div:
PLATFORM 1: BI semantic model on the Warehouse• Composite model: Imported dimensions + aggregates, DirectQuery for large or highly restricted facts
• Row-level security roles on top of schema security
• Import refresh triggered when the DW publishes, not on a fixed clock
• Broad HR audience consumes headcount, attrition, leave, mobility, planning, executive summary

div.div:
PLATFORM 2: Dashboards on the Lakehouse Gold layer• Live ops dashboard: Every click queries Gold views (minutes-old data)
• Business dashboards import Gold on a staggered schedule to avoid warehouse contention
• Each refresh starts after the upstream cycle it depends on
• Federated context read once per refresh, not per click

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D1 - Two platforms, not one Decision: keep the trusted nightly warehouse; add a lakehouse for event and integration use cases. Alternatives: migrate everything to the lakehouse; add near-real-time loads to the warehouse. Why: no big-bang migration risk; each platform does what it is best at. Revisit when: most consumers need sub-day freshness. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 32px; height: 1px; padding-top: 238px; margin-left: 1145px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D2 - Temporal ODS family Decision: separate current, effective-dated, future-dated, history and full ODS sharing one code base. Alternatives: a single SCD2 staging table; snapshots only. Why: back-dated corrections and future-dated changes are handled without corrupting current state; full replay is possible. Trade-off: more databases to run, mitigated by one commit promoted to all. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 26px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1108px; margin-left: 1108px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D3 - Dependency-tiered batch Decision: jobs start when their predecessors finish (dependency graph with gates); a small number of anchor jobs start on a clock. Alternatives: fixed clock schedule; one sequential chain. Why: independent work runs in parallel, the critical path shrinks, completion adapts to daily volume. Trade-off: the dependency graph must be maintained as configuration. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 26px; height: 1px; padding-top: 658px; margin-left: 1108px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D4 - Federation over replication Decision: the lakehouse reads conformed dimensions from the warehouse at query time through a few governed views. Alternatives: replicate dimensions into Delta; CDC copy. Why: one version of the truth, no sync lag, no duplicate pipelines. Guardrails: approved views only, resolve keys at ETL time, monitor latency and source load. Revisit when: concurrency or latency targets are missed, then materialize. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 32px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2383px; margin-left: 1145px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D5 - Blocking vs alerting data quality Decision: a blocking gate before the warehouse publish; alert-only checks in the lakehouse. Why: enterprise reporting should show yesterday's good data rather than today's bad data; operational integrations must keep flowing and reconcile later. Alternatives: block everywhere; alert everywhere. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 26px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2213px; margin-left: 667px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D6 - BI tool by audience Decision: composite BI model for the broad governed audience; live SQL dashboard for a small ops team; imported dashboards for lakehouse business users. Why: match freshness, row-level security and cost to who is reading. Alternatives: one tool and one refresh mode for everyone. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 26px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2688px; margin-left: 2288px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D7 - Medallion only where it adds value Decision: an integration gets Bronze/Silver/Gold only if it builds history, has an analytical audience and answers questions no other source can. One integration is deliberately skipped. Why: avoids building and running models nobody uses. Revisit when: a new audience or question appears. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 26px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2178px; margin-left: 2288px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D8 - Change detection by content compare Decision: detect changes by comparing content (set-based compare, or row hash for wide entities), excluding volatile columns such as load stamps. Alternatives: source timestamps; full nightly reload; database-native CDC. Why: timestamps produce false changes and miss real ones; downstream feeds should receive only true changes. Trade-off: compare cost grows with width and volume; excluded-column list must be maintained. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 26px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1555px; margin-left: 612px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D9 - Idempotent loads and safe re-runs Decision: every load is safe to run twice. Watermarks advance only after full success; upserts instead of blind inserts; additive merges only with a run log that rejects already-processed inputs. Alternatives: manual cleanup before re-runs; truncate-and-reload everything. Why: any failed job can be re-run without analysis, with no gaps and no double counting. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 26px; height: 1px; padding-top: 767px; margin-left: 1102px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D10 - Kimball dimensional model Decision: star schema / constellation with conformed dimensions, SCD Type 2 where history matters, role-playing dimensions and several fact types. Alternatives: 3NF enterprise model; Data Vault; reporting on raw views. Why: intuitive for a large self-service audience and BI tools; consistent KPIs; fast queries. Trade-off: ETL build effort; schema changes ripple through the model. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 26px; height: 1px; padding-top: 2215px; margin-left: 242px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D11 - Defense-in-depth security Decision: layered controls: schema separation by sensitivity tier, row-level security in BI, DirectQuery for highly restricted facts, restricted data kept out of federation, data minimization for feeds. Alternatives: row-level security only; separate physical databases per tier. Why: a failure in one layer does not expose data. Trade-off: role mappings must stay in sync across layers. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 26px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1631px; margin-left: 1102px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D12 - Bronze captures transient source data Decision: capture every inbound payload as received, append-only, before it is transformed, encrypted or forwarded. Why: some sources keep no history; without capture, trend analysis and replay are impossible. Trade-off: retention cost; raw sensitive data in Bronze must be governed. Click to open the ADR.

ellipse.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(15, 23, 42), rgb(211, 218, 234)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(251, 191, 36), rgb(122, 70, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 26px; height: 1px; padding-top: 1405px; margin-left: 2272px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FBBF24;
display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#FBBF24, #7a4600); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

a.title: D13 - Fact and dimension design patterns Decision: consolidated facts with a source-type column when several systems record the same event; junk dimensions for low-cardinality flags; weighted bridges for many-to-many; role-playing dimensions. Alternatives: one fact per source; flags on facts; unweighted bridges. Why: one place to query, correct totals, leaner facts. Click to open the ADR.

div.div:
F1 - Nightly run fails part-way• Extraction window is NOT advanced (postload runs only on full success)
• Next run re-extracts the same window → no data gaps
• Resume from the failed step using restart flags

div.div:
F2 - DQ gate below threshold• Publish stopped · previous warehouse version stays live
• BI keeps yesterday's import · alert raises a ticket
• Fix the data, then re-run only the publish step

div.div:
F3 - Integration record or API call fails• Record marked FAILED, the batch continues
• Token refresh + retries · scheduled retry or manual reprocess
• Replay from Bronze / raw event archive

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 436px; height: 1px; padding-top: 4236px; margin-left: 1407px;

div.div:
F4 - Federation slow or enterpriswarehouse unavailable• Lakehouse keeps its last good Gold layer
• Unresolved worker → unknown-member key, reconciled after DW publish; alert if still unresolved
• If it keeps happening: materialize the hot views (D4)

div.div:
F5 - Late or back-dated source changes• Effective-dated ODS catches back-dated corrections → merged into current
• SCD2 history corrected, not overwritten
• Future-dated changes held until their effective date (D2)
